correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the final real two-dimensional theorem from the actual frozen RESULT.md and seven Git blob hashes. Unit ball is the six intersections of signed facets ±s, ±t, ±(s-t). For unit x,y with x!=±y let A=N(x+y)>0, B=N(x-y)>0. Dual support forms f,g attaining A,B yield A+B <= max_{f,g}(||f+g||_*+||f-g||_*)=3; each A,B<=2. The desired cosine <=1/4 is equivalent to q=2A^2+2B^2-AB<=8. If s=A+B<=2, q=2s^2-5AB<=8; if 2<=s<=3, (2-A)(2-B)>=0 implies AB>=2s-4, giving q<=2s^2-10s+20<=8 by convexity and endpoint values 8. For x=(1,1),y=(1,0), A=2,B=1 and cosine=(4+1-4)/(2*2*1)=1/4. Independently reconstructed the tree SHA f7253024a1d326e0bf7dded092ef3c755cbb0eee from all seven actual Git blob SHA-1s; independently derived the six vertices and 36 facet-pair table exactly. Exhaustive rational 180-point edge-grid gives 32040 admissible pairs consistent with the sharp bound; this finite grid is corroboration, not its proof. Yang–Li Definition 3.1 is used as a formula in dimension two, despite its introductory dim>2 convention, as Remark 3.2 explicitly discusses two dimensions.
residual_risks: The source primary article has a preliminary dim X>2 convention even though its invariant definition and immediate Remark 3.2 discuss two-dimensional Euclidean spaces; this assessment proves the displayed formula for dimension two, not every downstream theorem in that article.
The 32040 finite grid pairs and 36 facet pairs are exact checks of finitely reducible steps only; the all-pairs conclusion uses the written analytic inequality.
No formal proof assistant or independent human attestation was performed.

value.rationale: This exact invariant is mathematically motivated: the affine-regular hexagon is the smallest centrally symmetric non-parallelogram polygon and a canonical non-Hilbert Radon normed plane, while Yang–Li S_P measures departure from the Hilbert relation via a concrete unit-pair angular supremum. The exact 1/4 locates this canonical model strictly between Hilbert zero and the universal 1/2 endpoint and supplies a sharp 6-facet benchmark distinct from the ell_p and regular-octagon cases. The reusable sharp support-functional bound N(x+y)+N(x-y)<=3 and explicit attaining pair make the fact independently reproducible and usable for comparing other polyhedral angular constants. A natural exact one-plane invariant can be valuable even without a full polygon classification; this is not merely a renamed known constant or a negative normalization check.
residual_risks: This is one exact plane-specific calculation rather than a general classification, and no downstream theorem is claimed.
Its value depends on no earlier identical or mechanically implying theorem being found; novelty search has nonzero residual risk.

limitations: Only the Yang–Li displayed P-angle formula in the real hexagonal plane is proved; no all-polygons classification or monotonicity claim.
Primary defining paper has a preliminary dim X>2 convention but explicitly discusses the same formula in 2D in Remark 3.2.
Exact same-id Resultary mirror is not independent priority evidence.
MDPI angle-moduli full text was not accessible (HTTP 429); its excerpt studies different moduli.
No independent human or Lean certification is represented.
